briefTitle: This is a Study to Learn About How the Combination of the Study Medicines Sigvotatug Vedotin Plus Pembrolizumab Works in People With Non-small Cell Lung Cancer With High Levels of PD-L1.

typedChecks.sourceText: Have pathologically confirmed Stage IIIB or IIIC NSCLC and not be a candidate for surgical resection or definitive chemoradiation, or Stage IV NSCLC per the AJCC Staging Manual (Version 8.0) and the UICC Staging System (Eighth edition).
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Have pathologically confirmed Stage IIIB or IIIC NSCLC and not be a candidate for surgical resection or definitive chemoradiation, or Stage IV NSCLC per the AJCC Staging Manual (Version 8.0) and the UICC Staging System (Eighth edition).

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants with known AGAs including EGFR, ALK, ROS1, NTRK, BRAF, RET, and MET, for which there are approved and available first-line therapies per local SOC are ineligible. Documented negative results for EGFR, ALK, and ROS1 AGAs are required for participants with non-squamous histology.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: This rule includes multiple actionable genomic alterations dependent on local standard of care approvals and histology subtyping, which cannot be expressed as a single typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants with large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma are excluded.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma exclusion is a specific subtype exclusion not mapped to standard typed histologies.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Must be an appropriate candidate for treatment with pembrolizumab monotherapy per local guidelines.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Investigator or clinical judgment of appropriateness for pembrolizumab monotherapy is subjective.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Measurable disease based on RECIST v1.1 per investigator.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Resolution of acute effects of any prior therapy to either baseline severity or NCI CTCAE Grade 1 or less (except for AEs not constituting a safety risk in the investigator's judgment), unless otherwise excluded.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Includes investigator judgment regarding safety risk and adverse event resolution.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Life expectancy of <3 months in the opinion of the investigator.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Life expectancy is a subjective clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Any medical or psychiatric condition including recent (within the past year) or active suicidal ideation/behavior or laboratory abnormality that may increase the risk of study participation or make the participant inappropriate for the study.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Broad investigator discretion regarding medical/psychiatric conditions and laboratory abnormalities.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants with any history of another malignancy within 3 years before the first dose of study intervention, or any evidence of residual disease from a previously diagnosed malignancy.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex prior malignancy history with multiple duration criteria.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Known or suspected hypersensitivity, intolerance, or contraindication to any excipient contained in the drug formulation of sigvotatug vedotin or pembrolizumab.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Hypersensitivity and contraindications are subjective clinical determinations.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants with any of the following respiratory conditions: Evidence of noninfectious or drug-induced ILD or pneumonitis; Known DLCO (adjusted for hemoglobin) <50% predicted; Grade ≥3 pulmonary disease unrelated to underlying malignancy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Combines multiple complex pulmonary assessments including DLCO cutoffs and unspecified Grade 3 pulmonary diseases.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Major surgery (defined as a surgery requiring inpatient hospitalization of at least 48 hours) within 21 days or minor surgery (excluding peripherally inserted central catheter placement and implantable central venous port placement) within 3 days prior to first dose of study intervention.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex surgical washout periods dependent on surgery classification.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Receipt of a live vaccine within 30 days prior to first dose of study intervention.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Live vaccine washout window is not a standard lab cutoff or prior therapy category.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Pre-existing peripheral neuropathy Grade ≥2 per NCI CTCAE v5.0.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Peripheral neuropathy grade is not a typed check kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Uncontrolled diabetes mellitus, defined as HbA1c ≥8.0% or HbA1c between 7.0% and 8.0% with associated diabetes symptoms (polyuria or polydipsia) that are not otherwise explained.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Diabetes control rule combines HbA1c ranges with symptom criteria.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Prior immune-related AE that led to anti-PD-(L)1 treatment discontinuation, required a high-dose steroid taper (≥0.5 mg/kg prednisone or equivalent per day) for >2 weeks, or required treatment with systemic immunosuppressive therapy.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex immune-related adverse event history and steroid tapering requirements.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of autoimmune disease that has required systemic treatment in the past 2 years
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Autoimmune disease history with systemic treatment timeframe.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants with prior solid organ or bone marrow transplantation.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Solid organ or bone marrow transplant history.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Currently receiving a high-dose steroid (>10 mg prednisone or equivalent per day) or other immune suppressant or has a condition requiring a chronic high-dose steroid or immune suppressant.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Current steroid dose threshold and chronic immunosuppressant requirements.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Prior and concomitant therapy: Any prior treatment with MMAE-derived drugs or IB6 targeting agents. Prior systemic therapy, including anti-PD-(L)1 therapy, for locally advanced, unresectable, or metastatic NSCLC... Prior radiotherapy to the lung within 6 months... Chemotherapy, biologics, and/or other antitumor treatment... Any prior therapy with an immune-oncology agent directed to a stimulatory or co-inhibitory T-cell receptor
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex combination of prior therapies, target agents, radiation intervals, and exceptions based on recurrence timing.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of or current ongoing infection, including participants positive for active HIV, HBV, or HCV.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Active infection status including viral hepatitis and HIV.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Severe uncontrolled cardiac or cerebrovascular condition within the previous 6 months
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Cardiovascular and cerebrovascular conditions within a specific timeframe.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Prior and concomitant therapy: Any prior treatment with MMAE-derived drugs or IB6 targeting agents. Prior systemic therapy, including anti-PD-(L)1 therapy, for locally advanced, unresectable, or metastatic NSCLC. (Neo)adjuvant anti-PD-(L)1 is allowed if recurrence or progression occurred ≥9 months after the last dose. Other (neo)adjuvant or definitive therapy is allowed if recurrence or progression occurred ≥6 months after the last dose. Prior radiotherapy to the lung within 6 months of first dose of study intervention, referencing the last date radiotherapy was received. This includes both curative and palliative radiotherapy. Chemotherapy, biologics, and/or other antitumor treatment with immunotherapy not specifically prohibited that is completed less than 4 weeks prior to first dose of study intervention, or 2 weeks for palliative radiotherapy. Any prior therapy with an immune-oncology agent directed to a stimulatory or co-inhibitory T-cell receptor
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Multi-layered prior therapy rules, classes, and complex recurrence time windows.

fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: General infection history and viral status criteria.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Severe uncontrolled cardiac or cerebrovascular condition within the previous 6 months
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Subjective cardiac or cerebrovascular condition assessment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Tumor has PD-L1 expression in ≥50% of tumor cells (TPS ≥50%) as determined by local testing.
